description: Generate a UPI payment QR code (PNG image) for an Indian UPI ID that PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm, BHIM and every UPI app can scan, optionally with a fixed amount and note. Also returns the upi:// link and a proupiqr.in page to download a printable counter poster or stickers. Nothing is stored. It never moves money: the payer approves the payment in their own UPI app.

amount.description: Optional amount in rupees, e.g. 499 or "1250.50". Leave it out and the payer types the amount.

note.description: Optional note shown to the payer and on statements, e.g. "Invoice 42". Up to 80 characters.

payee_name.description: Name the payer's UPI app shows: the shop, business or person.

upi_id.description: Payee UPI ID (VPA), e.g. ramesh@okaxis or 9876543210@ybl.

name: generate_upi_qr_code
title: Generate UPI QR code
